title: Report Allowance by Timeliness of the Death Notice (Occupancy and Residency Certification)
content:
**Rule.** When an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is reclassified after a certifying borrower's death and its passed due date is re-dated, the survivor allowance includes a **report allowance** measured by how soon the death notice was received after the date of death it states:

1. **14 days** where the death notice was received no more than 30 calendar days after the date of death it states, a notice received before that date counting as received on it;
2. **7 days** where it was received more than 30 and no more than 90 calendar days after it;
3. **zero days** where it was received later still.

The death notice read is the accepted death notice on file for the profile received most recently.

## Boundaries

| Calendar days from the date of death to the notice's receipt | Report allowance |
|---|---|
| received before the date of death stated (counts as 0) | 14 days |
| 0 to 30 | 14 days |
| 31 to 90 | 7 days |
| 91 or more | zero days |

*Hypothetical case.* A notice received exactly 30 days after the stated date of death earns 14 days; one received on the 31st day earns 7.
